# Computer Modern Sans Serif

Unmodified Computer Modern Unicode Sans webfonts from
https://github.com/bitmaks/cm-web-fonts/tree/333f55ec19733c28cdc43567ecf72eafd6b0af61/font/Sans
(regular, bold, italic and bold italic). This is Sans, not Bright or Serif.

Original fonts by Donald Knuth et al.; Unicode fonts by Andrey V. Panov;
webfont conversion by Christian Perfect. Distributed under SIL OFL 1.1.
The complete upstream copyright and licence are retained in LICENSE.txt and
the typography stylesheet's preserved licence comment, including in UI builds.

Fonts are served with each UI, not requested from an external CDN. Vite hashes
their URLs for caching. Only the faces used by a page are downloaded. Keep code
and technical logs monospace. Synchronize this folder, typography.css and
styles.css into the apps repository's shared-UI vendor snapshot when updating.
